claims.claim_ar: تكرار لفظ الجذر «أنزل» (ظاهرياً في مواقع الحكم والابتعاد عن الهوى) كوسيلة بلاغية للتوكيد وربط الحكم بالوحي
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the verb root "أنزل" (as seen in contexts of judgment vs. following desires) functions rhetorically to emphasize and to link the legal/ethical ruling to divine revelation.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال «إنَّ» (وردت في طرق التلاوة/القراءة كـ «وإنّ أكثركم») لتأكيد الحكم الخطابي بقوة: أي تأكيد خبرية القول بأن كثيراً من الناس فاسقون
claims.claim_en: Use of the particle "إنَّ" (attested in a reading as "وإنّ أكثركم") functions to strongly assert/emphasize the proposition that many among people are transgressors.
claims.needs_review_reason: The tafsir chunk records a variant reading/wording («أكثركم») differing from the printed ayah wording («كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ»); the rhetorical classification rests on that reported reading and on contextual interpretation.

warnings: Source chunks provided are from Zamakhshari's al-Kashshaf; the developer prompt requested extracts from al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti and tafsir-balagha sections. Only the given chunks were used.

Some claims rely on variant readings or on interpretive remarks in the tafsir (e.g. «وإنّ أكثركم») rather than on an exact verbatim match to the canonical printed verse; such cases are flagged in needs_review_reason.

Only rhetorical phenomena that could be tied to exact substrings in the provided chunks were extracted. Other likely devices in the verse (e.g. antithesis between following revelation and following desires, iltifat in address) were not claimed because no exact supporting substring for those devices appeared in the supplied chunks.
